# Bulk write exception types and partial results in the C#, Java and Rust drivers — facts

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] C# MongoBulkWriteException exposes individual operation errors through WriteErrors and the write concern error separately through WriteConcernError. The typed exception inherits these properties. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo-csharp-driver/main/src/MongoDB.Driver/MongoBulkWriteException.cs · keywords: Bulk write exception types and partial results in the C#, Java and Rust drivers · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-csharp-driver/blob/main/src/MongoDB.Driver/MongoBulkWriteException.cs
- [statement] Java getWriteErrors() is non-null but may be empty when a write concern error exists. getWriteConcernError() may be null; when it is null, the write-error list is nonempty. Inspect both channels when handling MongoBulkWriteException. (high confidence) — https://mongodb.github.io/mongo-java-driver/5.6/apidocs/driver-core/com/mongodb/MongoBulkWriteException.html · keywords: Bulk write exception types and partial results in the C#, Java and Rust drivers · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo-java-driver/main/driver-core/src/main/com/mongodb/MongoBulkWriteException.java
- [statement] Rust represents an insert_many failure with ErrorKind::InsertMany(InsertManyError). This is the collection insert-many error variant to inspect within the bounded collection-write scope. (high confidence) — https://docs.rs/mongodb/3.3.0/mongodb/error/enum.ErrorKind.html · keywords: Bulk write exception types and partial results in the C#, Java and Rust drivers · also: https://docs.rs/mongodb/3.3.0/src/mongodb/error.rs.html
- [statement] Rust InsertManyError does not publicly expose its inserted_ids map: the source declares that field pub(crate) and marks it with serde(skip), while the public API lists only write_errors and write_concern_error plus private fields. Applications cannot obtain that internal partial inserted-ID map through the public exception fields. (high confidence) — https://docs.rs/mongodb/3.3.0/src/mongodb/error.rs.html · keywords: Bulk write exception types and partial results in the C#, Java and Rust drivers · also: https://docs.rs/mongodb/3.3.0/mongodb/error/struct.InsertManyError.html

## Facts and statements

- [statement] The C# source defines MongoBulkWriteException<TDocument> as the typed bulk-write exception. Its Result property exposes BulkWriteResult<TDocument>, and UnprocessedRequests exposes the write models that were not processed. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo-csharp-driver/main/src/MongoDB.Driver/MongoBulkWriteException.cs · keywords: Bulk write exception types and partial results in the C#, Java and Rust drivers · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-csharp-driver/blob/main/src/MongoDB.Driver/MongoBulkWriteException.cs
- [statement] Rust InsertManyError publicly exposes write_errors as an optional vector of IndexedWriteError and write_concern_error as an optional WriteConcernError, separating individual write failures from write concern failures. (high confidence) — https://docs.rs/mongodb/3.3.0/mongodb/error/struct.InsertManyError.html · keywords: Bulk write exception types and partial results in the C#, Java and Rust drivers · also: https://docs.rs/mongodb/3.3.0/src/mongodb/error.rs.html
- [statement] Java MongoBulkWriteException represents bulk operation errors and exposes individual BulkWriteError entries through getWriteErrors(). The AWS guide independently demonstrates catching this exception around collection.bulkWrite() and iterating those entries. (medium confidence) — https://mongodb.github.io/mongo-java-driver/5.6/apidocs/driver-core/com/mongodb/MongoBulkWriteException.html · keywords: Bulk write exception types and partial results in the C#, Java and Rust drivers · also: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/documentdb/latest/devguide/java-crud-operations.html
